headline: Mooring and Stlican Tallies Shift as Weathered Expanse Bleeds
war_summary: Three hours have sharpened the tally on the old fronts. Weathered Expanse, the war's bloodiest field, lost a post outright — its standings now read five Colonials to three Wardens with one base in ruin — and the two-hour ledger counted better than 2,200 fallen on each side, the latest exchange logged as this edition closed. Mooring County's Warden garrison counted a gain, ten posts to two, though the fighting about Gravekeeper's Holdfast and The Cut ran heavy, some 2,300 Colonial and 2,100 Warden casualties in two hours. Stlican Shelf ticked likewise in Colonial favor, six bases to three, with Fort Hoarfrost again the busiest post. A new fire burns at Palantine Berm, where the region's only base actions of the day — three exchanges at Leiri Hermanni — flared around nightfall as casualties leapt to the hundreds. Callahan's Passage and the Nevish Line keep their grim arithmetic, casualty counts swelling hourly though no post changes hands, while the Dead Lands cools and Stonecradle keeps its morning quiet. It is day 365; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
